text:
Maria G: Heads up — multiple FinCap customers report Console graphs not loading this morning. They see spinning frames and when I check network we get 500s from analytics-api /v1/query. Screenshot posted: https://img.redwood.internal/err123.png :eyes:

Devin L: I can repro in prod with my account. Quick curl shows 500: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://analytics.redwood.ai/v1/query \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE org_id=\"fincap\" AND ts > now()-3600"}'
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Date: Mon, 10 Feb 2025 09:12:01 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"internal server error: clickhouse read timeout"}
```

support-bot: Incident created: #INC-2025-042 (analytics-api 500s). Paging oncall.

Jay (sre): I'm looking at analytics-api logs — seeing a surge of slow queries and a lot of `ReadTimeout` from ClickHouse shards around 09:10-09:20 UTC. Error snippet from api logs: 
```
[t=2025-02-10T09:11:45Z] ERROR analytics.query.exec id=abc123 org=fincap trace=... "clickhouse read timeout after 30s"
```

Devin L: The UI query payload is large for some panels (group_by on user_id + nested metrics). Could be high-cardinality causing long tail. I also reproduced an empty panel where the request payload was ~120KB.

Maria G: Customer says charts were fine until ~09:08 then degraded. They have spike in events ingestion at 09:05. Might be correlated.

Jay (sre): I'm keeping ClickHouse traces open. Initial theory: new query planner change rolled yesterday increased parallelism for some group-by paths, causing heavier load and some read timeouts under burst. Rolling back that change to previous planner for prod-query-service now as a hotfix.

Ashley P: Please add a status page message and let FinCap support contact know the engineering team is investigating. I'll draft a short blurb: "We're investigating intermittent graph load failures (500s) from analytics API; workaround: reduce time range or refresh in 30s." :+1:

Devin L: Short-term mitigation for support: advise customers to set time range to last 1 hour or remove high-cardinality groupings. Also turning on 'fetch_preview=false' in the Console reduces payload size. Example API workaround: 
```
POST /v1/query
{"query":"...","timeout_ms":15000}
```

Customer: FinCap: We're seeing this on all dashboards — very urgent, some customers relying on SLA. Any ETA?

Jay (sre): Hotfix rollback started at 09:27 UTC; metrics show reduced latency for queries to ClickHouse. I'm watching error rate; if error 500s drop to near-zero in next 10 min we'll call it mitigated.

Maria G: Noted. I'll reply to FinCap with the workaround and say we're deploying a rollback; will update in 15.

support-bot: Update: #INC-2025-042 status -> Investigating -> Mitigating (hotfix rollback in progress).

Devin L: Post-rollback logs show fewer timeouts, but one shard still shows intermittent 504s — possibly disk saturation. Jay can you run a quick health check on CH shard-3?

Jay (sre): Running check now — io wait high on shard-3, kicking off a short rebalancer and raising replica priority. If that doesn't clear we'll failover traffic for shard-3 in the next 5.

Ashley P: I'll prep a follow-up message to all impacted customers and link to status. Maria, please include repro steps and the curl sample so support can triage new reports faster.

Maria G: Will do. Keeping thread open. Will post final when the error rate is back to normal. :white_check_mark:
